observation: C04 calls _confirmed_money_in, which checks payer/root/currency/type/confirmed status and summed amount, but does not match each movement idempotency_key and allocation to settlement_plan_json. A prior refund against this same capture for the same amount could be incorrectly reused as evidence of the current cancellation.
concrete_scenario: Two-day rental paid 500; shortened to one day 250 and already refunded 250. Cancellation owes remaining 250. Executor returns the prior change refund ID; current checks can accept that old receipt without paying cancellation.
required_closure: Add negative reproduction for same-order previous equal-amount refund, and one-to-one match all returned persisted receipt tuples (root_payment_intent_id,parent_movement_id,amount_minor,idempotency_key) against the exact frozen settlement plan before completion. Preserve owner/currency/status/original-capture checks and retry semantics.
